pokedexEntries.rb: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

pokedexEntries.ye: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can’t stop from picking them up.

pokedexEntries.go: It is fascinated by round objects. It can’t stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.

pokedexEntries.si: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.

pokedexEntries.cr: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines too.

pokedexEntries.rs: MEOWTH withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this POKéMON loves shiny coins that glitter with light.

pokedexEntries.fr: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

pokedexEntries.lg: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

pokedexEntries.em: MEOWTH withdraw their sharp claws into their paws to silently sneak about. For some reason, this POKéMON loves shiny coins that glitter with light.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

pokedexEntries.hg: It is fascinated by round objects. It can’t stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.

pokedexEntries.ss: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.

pokedexEntries.bw: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

pokedexEntries.x: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

pokedexEntries.y: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

pokedexEntries.oras: Meowth withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this Pokémon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.

pokedexEntries.su: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.

pokedexEntries.mo: It loves shiny things. It often fights with Murkrow over prey they’re both trying to catch.

pokedexEntries.us: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

pokedexEntries.um: It loves coins, so if you give it one, you can make friends with Meowth easily. But it’s fickle, so you can’t count on that friendship lasting.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can’t stop itself from picking them up.

pokedexEntries.sw: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

pokedexEntries.sh: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It is nocturnal by nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter as brightly as the shiny object.
